en-US.name: Focus Mode
en-US.summary: Pomodoro-style focus rounds with spoken checkpoints and break timers.
en-US.description: Focus Mode runs numbered 30-minute focus rounds indefinitely. Alexa checks in halfway and five minutes before the end of each round, then the break (5 minutes after odd rounds, 10 after even) ends with a normal ringing timer. The next round never starts automatically.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Focus Mode to pause
Alexa, ask Focus Mode how much time is left
